$comment: Copilot Studio tool definition (configuration artifact). Mirrors backend/app/agents/tools.py and connector-openapi.yaml.
name: CreateTicket
description: Creates an IT support ticket for the signed-in user when something is broken, failing, slow or showing an error, or when the user explicitly asks to open a ticket. Always confirm title, category and priority with the user first. Do not use for access requests.

title.description: Short summary of the problem, e.g. 'Laptop screen flickering'.

description.description: What happens, error messages and what the user already tried. Never include passwords or secrets.

priority.description: P1 many users/critical system down, P2 one user blocked, P3 degraded (default), P4 question.

Idempotency-Key.description: Set by the agent, not asked from the user.
